translations.web: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.
translations.bsb: Its portico faced the outer court, and its side pillars were decorated with palm trees. Eight steps led up to it.
translations.kjv: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
translations.asv: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
